research_question: How many divorces did the CDC record in 2024, what is the current rate, and what does the national series leave out?

research_brief.purpose: Owner-approved statistics page for divorce statistics, rebuilt from the owner draft after a live fact-check.
research_brief.audience: Readers, students, journalists, and legal professionals in the United States who need sourced figures.
research_brief.data_period: CDC/NCHS provisional national marriage and divorce tables, 2000-2024; CDC FastStats as displayed 2026-11-10
research_brief.scope_limitations: Reporting-area data exclude five states (CA, HI, IN, MN, NM) in 2018-2024; no missing state is estimated. Census Bureau page in owner draft returned 404 and was replaced with CDC FastStats.

queries.keyword: what are the divorce statistics in the us

competitors.gaps: Mixes measures and years; dated studies; no reporting-area caveat.

competitors.gaps: Survey measures, not CDC event counts; no 2024 CDC table.

competitors.gaps: No trend, no explanation of crude rate or missing states.

competitors.title: Divorce Statistics Across America

content_gaps: Ranking pages rarely name the excluded states.
Crude rates are presented as the share of marriages ending.
Few pages show the 2000-2024 CDC trend with the 2024 figures.
value_add: Names the five excluded states, calculates reporting-area coverage (about 84%), shows the 25-year CDC trend, and separates four divorce measures in one table.
